description: Stratus Red Team cloud adversary-emulation techniques for GCP targeting the Persistence tactic. Each script invokes the official Stratus binary using an isolated Morgana correlation ID for Detection Fabric correlation. Prerequisite cloud infrastructure is managed by Stratus warmup. Cleanup is performed via the separate cleanup_command using the same correlation ID.
purpose: Validate GCP Persistence detection rules, SIEM alerts, and SOC workflows in an authorized cloud sandbox.
capabilities: 2 Stratus Red Team techniques for GCP Persistence.
Official Stratus binary execution — no custom attack code.
Morgana Test ID used as Stratus correlation ID for Detection Fabric correlation.
Separate detonate + cleanup lifecycle with state preservation.
use_cases: Validate GCP Persistence detection in an authorized cloud sandbox.
Exercise SIEM, CSPM, cloud-native detection, and SOC workflows with real cloud API activity.
Confirm detection rules fire on real technique execution before incident response exercises.
prerequisites: GCP Application Default Credentials configured (gcloud auth application-default login).
GCP project with appropriate IAM permissions.
Authorized test GCP project — never run against production.
safety_notes: Stratus Red Team is designed for authorized sandbox cloud environments only.
Never execute against production cloud accounts, subscriptions, or clusters.
Some techniques create real cloud resources that incur cost — always run cleanup after detonation.
Warmup may take 1–5 minutes for Terraform-based infrastructure setup.
Cleanup uses the same correlation ID; ensure MORGANA_TEST_ID matches the detonation Test.

scripts.name: STRATUS - GCP - Create an Admin GCP Service Account
scripts.description:
Stratus Red Team cloud adversary-emulation technique for GCP.

Create an Admin GCP Service Account

Establishes persistence by creating a new service account and assigning it owner permissions inside the current GCP project. Warm-up: None Detonation: - Create a service account - Update the current GCP project's IAM policy to bind the service account to the owner role' References: - https://about.gitlab.com/blog/2020/02/12/plundering-gcp-escalating-privileges-in-google-cloud-platform/

Morgana executes the official Stratus technique using an isolated MORGANA_TEST_ID correlation ID. Prerequisite infrastructure is handled by Stratus warmup. Cleanup uses the same correlation ID.
scripts.command:
# Stratus Red Team — Create an Admin GCP Service Account
# Correlation ID = Morgana Test ID for Detection Fabric correlation
STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID="${MORGANA_TEST_ID:-$(uuidgen 2>/dev/null || cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/uuid 2>/dev/null || echo manual)}"
export STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID

if [ -n "#{stratus_gcp_project}" ]; then export GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT="#{stratus_gcp_project}"; fi

# Select Stratus binary for this Agent OS
if command -v stratus >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  STRATUS_BIN=stratus
else
  STRATUS_BIN="{{asset:stratus_linux_amd64}}"
  chmod +x "$STRATUS_BIN" 2>/dev/null || true
fi

echo "[INFO] Stratus Red Team: technique=gcp.persistence.create-admin-service-account"
echo "[INFO] Correlation ID: $STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID"

# Warmup + Detonate
"$STRATUS_BIN" detonate gcp.persistence.create-admin-service-account
EXIT_CODE=$?

echo "[INFO] Detonation complete: exit=$EXIT_CODE technique=gcp.persistence.create-admin-service-account"
# Emit structured result
echo "MORGANA_RESULT_METADATA={\"provider\":\"stratus-red-team\",\"technique_id\":\"gcp.persistence.create-admin-service-account\",\"correlation_id\":\"$STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID\",\"exit_code\":$EXIT_CODE}"
exit $EXIT_CODE
scripts.cleanup_command:
# Stratus Red Team cleanup — uses SAME correlation ID as detonation
# MORGANA_TEST_ID must match the value used during detonate
STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID="${MORGANA_TEST_ID:-manual}"
export STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID

if command -v stratus >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  STRATUS_BIN=stratus
else
  STRATUS_BIN="{{asset:stratus_linux_amd64}}"
fi

"$STRATUS_BIN" cleanup gcp.persistence.create-admin-service-account
CLEANUP_EXIT=$?
echo "[INFO] Cleanup complete: exit=$CLEANUP_EXIT technique=gcp.persistence.create-admin-service-account"
exit $CLEANUP_EXIT

source_metadata.detection: Using the following GCP Admin Activity audit logs events: - google.iam.admin.v1.CreateServiceAccount - SetIamPolicy with resource.type=project
